_comment: myOS safety guard (scripts/guard.py for Claude Code, config/codex-guard.rules for Codex). Works under bypass/Yolo modes: deny = blocked outright, ask = the owner must confirm in the UI (headless runs treat ask as blocked). Set MYOS_GUARD=off in the environment before launching an agent to disable for that session.

production_hosts.app.example-prod.com: EXAMPLE production host - replace with your own (live system)
production_hosts.uat.example-prod.com: EXAMPLE staging host that shares the production box - replace or remove

_ask_as_note: Set to "deny" to turn every ask into a hard block. Use this if bypass-mode sessions do not actually show the confirmation prompt (UNVERIFIED for interactive Yolo sessions; headless -p always blocks).
_hosts_note: Commands that mutate these hosts (ssh, scp, deploy, POST/PUT/DELETE...) are denied unless the session sets MYOS_GUARD_ALLOW=production-host. Read-only health checks are allowed.
